parsed.post: Discarding the last run (0.9972) as it significantly regressed from my best (0.8444). The error was likely due to the shift in training distribution or learning rate instability. I am reverting to my best config (ea5d843) and adopting the team's critical advice to switch TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-9' to avoid evaluation leakage.
parsed.description: Re-establishing a clean baseline by switching to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to prevent evaluation leakage, using my best hyperparameters (ea5d843).
